title: LuckRead D1-01 to Neon PostgreSQL Schema Source Inventory Contract

owners.role: Payload/CMS schema authority and API boundary
owners.schemaMode: Generate a fresh PostgreSQL baseline using the official Payload PostgreSQL adapter; do not translate or execute D1 adapter migrations on PostgreSQL.

owners.role: Better Auth identity/session core and identity/account domain state
owners.schemaMode: Generate Better Auth core/plugin tables from the pinned Better Auth configuration/CLI; port W02-owned custom D1 SQL and all direct D1 query/transaction code separately.

owners.role: D1-01 subscription plan, subscription state and entitlement references only
owners.schemaMode: Port the D1-01 migration set to PostgreSQL; payment/order/financial facts remain in D1-04 and are not part of this domain bootstrap.

owners.role: Creator application and creator identity facts; RoleAssignment remains W02-owned
owners.schemaMode: Port the D1-01 creator authorization migration to PostgreSQL; preserve W02 role authority.

sharedInvariants: Do not import existing business rows.
Do not change production D1 bindings or production runtime adapters in this source-inventory stage.
Do not execute SQLite/D1 migration files on PostgreSQL.
Do not modify Payload Core or Better Auth upstream source.
Keep W01/W02/W07/W08 ownership boundaries explicit within the shared D1-01 physical database.
Keep all cross-domain references as opaque identifiers; do not add cross-database foreign keys.
Treat migration provenance rows as schema bookkeeping, not business data.
knownPortabilityReviewAreas: SQLite typeof/GLOB checks and JSON functions
SQLite RAISE(ABORT) trigger bodies and trigger syntax
Better Auth direct D1 binding and W02 custom D1Database prepare/batch transactions
PostgreSQL boolean, JSON/JSONB, text timestamp and partial-index semantics
executionOrder: Verify source inventory and current Worker-to-D1-01 mapping
Generate Payload PostgreSQL base migration using @payloadcms/db-postgres
Generate Better Auth 1.7.8 PostgreSQL schema from the canonical auth configuration
Port W02 custom identity SQL and transaction code with PostgreSQL tests
Port W07 D1-01 subscription/entitlement schema and tests
Port W08 creator schema and tests
Run one clean PostgreSQL 18 bootstrap and schema catalog comparison
Apply reviewed schema-only migration to Neon D1-01 and run read-only postflight
